title: Python: File upload without content-type validation
detail: File upload without MIME-type validation → malicious file upload. From BugHunter hunt-file-upload. Validate content-type and extension against allowlist. | Fix: Validate MIME type: import magic; mime = magic.from_buffer(file.read(2048), mime=True). Check extension against allowlist. Save outside webroot. | Source: BugHunter
pattern_title: Python: File upload without content-type validation
